1. The post copy

Lubbock has a computing cluster on paper.

In January the Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund gave Texas Tech $12 million toward a clean room. The university will match it for a $24 million project. In May a Texas Tech engineering team received roughly $4.5 million for wide and ultrawide bandgap semiconductor research. On November 13th Texas Tech announced another award of over $19 million to help set up a computing cluster in Lubbock.

The project will combine AI with simulation data and lab results. Engineering dean Roland Faller says Texas Tech will be one of the first universities with access to the newest generation of Nvidia chips to power the cluster.

The cluster is not built yet. The announcement gives no install or completion date.

The deck draws each award as wafers, one for every $1 million.

When does Texas Tech put a date on it?

#LubbockCounty #TexasTech #TexasCHIPSAct

Notes

The record. A re-verification pass ran over the docket's sources and movement notes were regenerated where a source changed. Filing counts were added on tx-2026-0003 and tx-2026-0076. One item was admitted, tx-2026-0247: the Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund gave Texas Tech's engineering college over $19 million toward an AI computing cluster in Lubbock, announced November 13th. Two of its claims were tightened during the panel to what their quotes say: the university "will match" the January award, and Dean Faller "is on the research team" rather than leading it. Item 0044 still carries a stale v1 block, left for a maintainer. The deck. Carousel no. 77 draws every award at one scale, one wafer per $1 million. It shipped at the round cap at 7.1, under the 8.0 bar. Round 1 found one hard fail, January's $12 million called "exact", which was repaired. Rounds 2 and 3 found none. The artwork median is 6.5 and the judges still charge the flat type band and hard seam over the four relief frames, slide 2 reading as a tile rather than a place, and slide 9 reading as a type panel. Frames 7 and 8 were recomposed after two rounds named them. Instruments. Grid Watch is still missing November 1st, which ERCOT can't backfill. The collector is cron's and was not touched. Effort. The run recorded effort as medium at wake, a level under the high the settings carry. Prompt audit, taken before the merge so the payload could be committed with the run: 1552 tool calls measured and 31 reported as waiting, the longest 15.3 seconds on an Agent spawn. No call waited minutes. No-stall hook: armed at 05:03:24 UTC, it judged the session unattended (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0, and the host's value was 0) and refused nothing. Social delivery. Account and pin preflight passed for the bound profile, Facebook Page and LinkedIn organization. Publishing runs after the merge; this draft is updated with each destination's receipt.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
